profile.verifiedVia: GET https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/apify~instagram-profile-scraper -- confirmed this exact build (buildNumberInt 587) is the actor's own 'latest' tag as of pin date
profile._comment: Fetches a single account's profile snapshot: follower count, following count, post count, bio, plus up to 12 latest posts. Output maps to competitor_snapshots (followersCount, followsCount, postsCount, biography). Already used ad-hoc this session for the verification worksheet (out/verification_worksheet.csv, source_actor column) -- 133K+ users on the actor, official apify/ namespace. Every call MUST pass build=0.0.587 explicitly (via the API's `build` query param), never rely on the actor's own 'latest' tag, which will silently drift to a newer build over time.

posts.verifiedVia: GET https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/apify~instagram-post-scraper -- confirmed this exact build (buildNumberInt 579) is the actor's own 'latest' tag as of pin date
posts._comment: Fetches recent posts for an account: caption, timestamp, likesCount, commentsCount, videoViewCount/type, across all post types (image/carousel/video), not reels-only. resultsLimit maps to posts_per_run; onlyPostsNewerThan maps to the last_scraped_at watermark in build_run_input.ts. dataDetailLevel MUST be detailedData -- confirmed via smoke_test.ts on 2026-08-25 that basicData omits video view count entirely (no videoViewCount/videoPlayCount field at all, even for Video/clips posts), which makes vpf permanently null. detailedData is a paid add-on (~$0.001/post extra on top of ~$0.0017/post base), trivial at this pipeline's scale. Every call MUST pass build=0.0.579 explicitly, never 'latest'.

transcript.verifiedVia: GET https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/apify~instagram-reel-scraper -- confirmed this exact build (buildNumberInt 549) is the actor's own 'latest' tag as of pin date
transcript._comment: Reel-specific actor (136K+ users, official apify/ namespace) with an includeTranscript add-on flag, billed per minute of audio -- only ever called with includeTranscript:true against a single post URL at a time, and only for posts already in v_outliers, never a batch scrape. Only applicable to video/reel posts -- an outlier that's a carousel or static image has no audio to transcribe and can't use this actor; that's a real scope gap (v_outliers doesn't currently distinguish post_type), flag before wiring ingest for transcripts. Output field names for the transcript itself (transcript text + timing) were not yet confirmed against a real response as of pinning -- ingest.ts's ingestTranscript() falls back across item.transcript / item.captionText defensively, but this should be confirmed against one real call before trusting it at volume. Every call MUST pass build=0.0.549 explicitly, never 'latest'.

tiktokSearch.verifiedVia: GET https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/clockworks~tiktok-scraper -- confirmed this exact build (buildNumberInt 597) is the actor's own 'latest' tag as of pin date; 243K+ total users
tiktokSearch._comment: discover.ts --search stage. searchQueries applies to both videos and profiles per the actor's own input schema description -- batch ALL seed queries for a sweep (or a market) into ONE call's searchQueries array, not one call per query: the actor has a $0.50 minimumMaxTotalChargeUsd per RUN (confirmed via pricing API), so many small single-query runs would multiply that minimum unnecessarily. resultsPerPage (DISCOVERY_SEARCH_RESULTS_PER_QUERY in config.ts) is the primary cost lever here. Every call MUST pass build=0.0.597 explicitly, never 'latest'.

tiktokPosts.verifiedVia: Same actor/build as tiktokSearch above -- confirmed its `profiles` input mode (pull a profile's own videos) via GET .../builds/default inputSchema on 2026-08-26
tiktokPosts._comment: discover.ts --gate stage. Same actor as tiktokSearch, different input mode: profiles instead of searchQueries. excludePinnedPosts:true is required -- confirmed on the 2026-08-26 AU run that 63.4% of resultsPerPage:1 results without it were TikTok's pinned post, not the actual most recent one (same failure mode as the Instagram pinned-post bug found earlier in this pipeline). Batch as many candidate handles as possible into one call for the same $0.50-per-run-minimum reason. resultsPerPage here is DISCOVERY_GATE_MAX_POSTS_PER_CANDIDATE in config.ts. This stage also now computes last_post_at (moved here from --profile/tiktokProfile, see that entry's comment) alongside video_posts_90d/median_vpf_90d -- it's the expensive stage: cost is candidates x posts-per-candidate, not just candidates. Every call MUST pass build=0.0.597 explicitly, never 'latest'.

tiktokProfile.verifiedVia: GET https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/clockworks~tiktok-profile-scraper -- confirmed this exact build (buildNumberInt 468) is the actor's own 'latest' tag as of pin date; 37K+ total users
tiktokProfile._comment: discover.ts --profile stage -- the CHEAP gate stage (revision 3): populates followers/bio/is_private and immediately fails candidates on followers<1000 or is_private, before any expensive post pull. last_post_at is deliberately NOT gated here (moved to tiktokPosts/--gate, see that entry's comment): confirmed on the 2026-08-26 AU run that resultsPerPage:1 without excludePinnedPosts returns TikTok's pinned post 63.4% of the time, not the actual most recent one, so this single item's createTime cannot be trusted for recency. followers/is_private are author-level metadata and unaffected by pinning, so they stay here. resultsPerPage MUST be 1: this actor's default is 100 posts/profile (it's a profile+videos scraper, not profile-only), so leaving it unset would make this 'cheap' stage cost ~100x more (confirmed via the actor's input schema on 2026-08-26 -- profileScrapeSections defaults to ['videos'], resultsPerPage defaults to 100). Batch candidates into one call, same per-run-minimum reasoning as tiktokSearch. Every call MUST pass build=0.0.468 explicitly, never 'latest'.

tiktokTranscript.verifiedVia: GET https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/clockworks~tiktok-transcript-extractor -- confirmed this exact build (buildNumberInt 68) is the actor's own 'latest' tag as of pin date; same clockworks/ publisher already trusted for tiktokSearch/tiktokPosts/tiktokProfile; 343 total users, 5-star rating (6 reviews), 98.8% run success rate over the last 30 days (1784/1806)
tiktokTranscript._comment: Pinned 2026-08-26 for Prompt 4 Step 4 -- v_outliers's first real result was a TikTok post, and the only transcript actor previously pinned (apify/instagram-reel-scraper) is Instagram-only. downloadSubtitlesOptions MUST be DOWNLOAD_SUBTITLES, not one of the TRANSCRIBE_* modes: DOWNLOAD_SUBTITLES reuses TikTok's own subtitle track when present (confirmed present on the first real target post via its raw.videoMeta.subtitleLinks field, captured by the harvest actor) for a flat ~$0.0037/video 'Video' charge; the TRANSCRIBE_* modes invoke real speech-to-text and are billed an EXTRA $0.048/started-minute on top (FREE tier pricing) -- for a multi-minute TikTok video that's ~10-15x more expensive for the same result whenever native subtitles already exist. Only reach for a TRANSCRIBE_* mode if DOWNLOAD_SUBTITLES comes back empty for a given post. Every call MUST pass build=0.0.68 explicitly, never 'latest'.
